## Comprehensive Project Portfolio

### 1. Tessera — AI Repository Intelligence Platform
- **Category:** AI / Full Stack
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Badge:** Built during Impact Forge: Summer 2026 Hackathon
- **Summary:** An AI-assisted GitHub repository analyzer that helps developers understand complex or unfamiliar codebases by offering evidence-grounded insights, interactive architecture visualization, code exploration, and quality auditing.
- **Key Features:**
  - Codebase structure analysis
  - Evidence-grounded architecture & security auditing powered by Gemini AI
  - Interactive Code Explorer
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Python, Supabase, Gemini AI
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itsvoidstack/tessera
- **Live Application:** https://tesseraa-app.netlify.app

### 2. Chroniqx — Media Tracking Platform
- **Category:** Media Tracking / Full Stack
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Summary:** Full-stack media tracking application featuring real-time user activity, automated tracking, and personalized libraries.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, External APIs, Vercel
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itsvoidstack/chroniq
- **Live Application:** https://chroniqx.vercel.app

### 3. ResQ-Nepal — SOS & Emergency Platform
- **Category:** Civic Tech / Web
- **Role:** Developer
- **Summary:** A civic emergency platform connecting individuals with emergency services, community assistance, and critical response resources.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, APIs, Vercel
- **Repository:** https://github.com/itsvoidstack/ResQ-Nepal

### 4. connect-grow — Multi-Role Collaboration Platform
- **Category:** Hackathon MVP / Web
- **Role:** Developer
- **Summary:** Multi-role collaboration concept enabling seamless interaction between businesses, workers, mentors, and students.
- **Tech Stack:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Tailwind CSS
